mechanism.summary: Extend the existing typed-loop CallNumericNative lowering from receiver-preserving CallResolved bytecode to ordinary Call bytecode with one or two scalar arguments, so a detached pure Math intrinsic held in an existing local can execute in the typed register loop instead of re-entering the generic VM call path.
mechanism.generality: The route is selected solely by existing loop bytecode, scalar register state, and the run-time identity of an unbound NativeFunction pure Math intrinsic. It applies to ordinary detached or locally stored numeric intrinsics in any admitted typed loop; it has no source-path, function-name, workload, input-size, iteration-count, checksum, call-graph, or benchmark-specific condition. A user function, bound function, non-Math native, non-numeric operand, unsupported arity, or any failed dense-array/typed-loop guard declines to the unchanged interpreter at the existing deoptimization site.
semantic_risks: plain Call has an undefined receiver while CallResolved preserves a receiver, so the new lowering must not share receiver-consuming behavior or admit an intrinsic whose result can observe this
the compiler must preserve the ordinary Call operand-stack order and its exact resume site when the native identity or a scalar operand guard fails
a local callee can hold a user function, bound function, proxy, or a changed value; every such case must decline before executing any native iteration
unsupported or missing arity, NaN, infinity, signed-zero, and two-argument Math semantics must continue to use the existing typed-loop math helpers or decline rather than duplicate arithmetic

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-28 /private/tmp/qjs-profile-3d-morph-05f-v3.sample; exact pinned SunSpider 3d-morph source (SHA-256 9a782188384af592c308338225f014cc7df246614f47f312cf71f29ed06e9f2d) plus a profile-only 3,000-call morph repetition whose generated source SHA-256 is 73346039c0a608ba4ccd0d7842ff99d48e1da2189cebed0cd7d17befb36478c7, executed by the exact 6cac-equivalent release binary
profile_evidence.shared_cost: All 7,419 execution samples enter the direct leaf for morph, but its inner detached sin(...) call remains on the generic VM path: Vm::run_completion contributes 1,442 samples at the call site, call_callee_with_marker 647, try_fast_global_native_call 190, and construction or destruction of the temporary CallEnv 324. The typed-loop compiler already lowers equivalent receiver-preserving CallResolved Math calls, but it has no Op::Call arm, leaving this otherwise scalar dense-array loop uninterpreted.
